title: FATE in MMLA: A Student-Centred Exploration of Fairness, Accountability, Transparency, and Ethics in Multimodal Learning Analytics
reasoning: The paper includes a primary research question (RQ4) dedicated to ethics, specifically exploring students' perceptions, decisions, and preferences regarding informed consent and ethical data handling within multimodal learning analytics systems. This evaluation of ethics is a central component of the study's qualitative analysis.
